# Metal Construction News

> Metal Construction News is the authoritative source for metal construction industry news, market analysis, awards recognition, and technical guidance for builders, architects, and contractors.

The site provides comprehensive coverage of the metal construction market including industry rankings, project awards, contractor surveys, employment trends, and technical resources on metal building systems and materials. Metal Construction News serves as a central hub for industry professionals seeking news, research, and recognition within the metal construction sector.

## Key Topics

- Metal Construction
- Metal Buildings
- Metal Building Manufacturers Association (MBMA)
- Associated Builders and Contractors (ABC)
- Project Excellence Awards
- Contractor Survey
- Industry Rankings
- Employment Trends
- Construction Market Analysis
- Metal Cladding
- Cold-Formed Steel
- Building Materials
- Metal Doors
- Nonresidential Construction
- Construction Regulations

- [MCN Contests](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/mcn-contests): Metal Construction News contests and MCN Project Excellence Awards entry information
- [Dr. Benjamin Schafer Earns MBMA's Duane S. Ellifritt Research Award](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/news/duane-s-ellifritt-research-award): Dr. Benjamin Schafer receives MBMA research award for cold-formed steel work

- [Metal Construction News 2025 Top Metal Builders](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/articles/features/2025-top-metal-builders): 2025 rankings of top metal builders with construction statistics and market analysis

- [Construction Industry Sees "Downbeat" Outlook with 11,000 Jobs Shed in February](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/news/construction-industry-february-2026-downbeat-outlook): Construction industry employment analysis showing 11,000 job losses in February 2026
- [Construction Job Openings Continue Downward Slide in January](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/news/construction-job-openings-january-2026): Construction job openings analysis showing continued decline in January 2026
- [Construction Input Prices Up Slight But Tariff Impacts Slowing](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/news/construction-input-prices-january-2026): Construction input price analysis with tariff impacts on steel and materials

## Technical Guides & Resources

- [Striking Metal Wall Exteriors with Aluminum Cladding and Battens](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/articles/striking-metal-wall-exteriors): Guide to metal wall exteriors with aluminum cladding and installation techniques
- [Enhanced Durability of Open-Joint Metal Cladding in Rainscreens](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/articles/open-joint-metal-cladding-rainscreens): Technical guide on open-joint metal cladding rainscreen systems and durability
- [The Role of Thermal Breaks in Rolling Steel Doors](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/articles/features/thermal-breaks-rolling-steel-doors): Technical guide on thermal breaks in rolling steel doors for energy efficiency
- [Metal Doors are as Versatile as Metal Buildings](https://www.metalconstructionnews.com/articles/metal-doors-metal-buildings): Guide to metal doors for buildings including bifold and hydraulic door specifications
